summary: Version tracking and release notes are now visible in the app.
details: Added a version number to the footer
Added a "What's new" panel to the left nav with full changelog history

summary: Minor Improvements the release notes panel
details: Some minor UI improvements to the release notes panel

summary: Added a new Companies and Locations system.
details: Added a "Location" option to the login portal.
Added custom theme customisation for each company.
Added the ability to upload a logo to show in the sidebar when logged in.
Fixed the "What's New" panel not ordering the changelog correctly.
Added some UI improvements to the Role and User Role Managment pages.
Added a fix for a bug that would cause a loading spinner to show for 5 seconds when loading any page.
Added a fix for a bug that would cause the Companies logo to be hidden on the sidebar in the mobile view
Added a new Help panel accessible from areas that have help documents available.
Users with the "Manager" role can now open the User and Role Management pages.
Users with the "Manager" role can now bulk-assign training courses.
Updated the site to use the specific Lanyard logos for the browser icon.

summary: Added rich interactions to the File Manager Page.
details: Added Folder Creation to the File Manager Page.
Added the ability to move files in the File Manager Page.
Added the ability to download files in the File Manager Page.
Added a new role "CanManageFiles" that allows users to manage files and folders in the File Manager Page.
Added a rate limit of 25 requests per minute for endpoints that are related to logging in and logging out.
Added a small UI improvement to the "My Training" card on the home page
Added UI updates to the Bulk Assign Course dialog to make it more user friendly.
Added the Company logo to the home page on the mobile interface.

summary: Managers can now create users, plus training history and file manager improvements.
details: Managers can now create, delete, and resend invites for users, matching Admin permissions.
The new-password invite email now shows the location to log in at.
Added a confirmation dialog before deleting a file in the File Manager.
Added the ability to edit a user's name, phone number, and date of birth on the Users page.
The company logo area in the side navbar is now hidden when no logo is set.
My Training and the manager's per-course and per-person training views now collapse multiple attempts into one row per course, expandable to see each attempt's score and result.
The kiosk text widget now supports rich text formatting (bold, italic, underline, lists).
Added 2fa support into the login system, enabled via the Account Managment Page

summary: Added email reminders for training assignments.
details: Users are now emailed when a training course is assigned to them.
Users are now emailed a reminder when an assigned course's due date is within 7 days and still incomplete.

summary: Login page overhaul with a company picker and optional background image.
details: Login now starts with a company-selection step before showing the username/password/location form, scoped to that company's locations.
Admins can set an optional login background image per company from the Companies and Locations page.
The login page's accent color now follows the selected company's brand color, and persists across a page refresh.
The mobile bottom navigation bar no longer shows on the login page until signed in.
Fixed the "Lanyard" wordmark rendering incorrectly on mobile browsers.
Fixed the login background not filling the full page height and an unwanted scrollbar on some screen sizes.

summary: Fixed slow volume dragging, a slow kiosk startup countdown, and made the Music page phone-friendly.
details: Fixed the volume slider on the Music page taking up to 20 seconds to reach the client after a drag - it now applies the change as soon as you release the slider.
Fixed the kiosk client's startup countdown taking around 20 seconds instead of the 5 seconds it displays.
The Music page now switches to a Playlists/Songs tab view on phone-sized screens instead of squeezing both side by side.
Added a Projection Control page showing every projection program currently running, which client and display it is on, and which step it is showing.
Projection programs can now be paused, resumed, stepped forwards or backwards, and stopped while they are playing.
A projection program triggered on a client now closes itself and returns the display to its normal programme once it has finished, instead of leaving its last step on screen.
The kiosk debug overlay now shows the current step and whether playback is paused.
Added a Kiosk Health dashboard widget listing every kiosk, offline ones first, with an online count and a "last seen" time for anything that has dropped.
The Kiosk Health widget can be set to show only offline kiosks, for a problems-only dashboard.
Kiosks now record when they disconnect, so downtime can be shown rather than just a bare online/offline state.
The Clients management page now refreshes on its own, so a kiosk going offline no longer needs a manual page reload to show up.
Logging out now goes straight to the login page instead of briefly showing an error screen on the way.
Passing a training course now emails you a branded PDF certificate automatically.
Added a "Download Certificate" button to the course completion dialog and to each completed course on My Training.
Certificates carry your company's logo and brand colour, and can be re-downloaded at any time.
Training emails now greet you by first name instead of your username.
Training emails and certificates now take their logo and brand colour from your own company, so everyone at a company gets consistent branding regardless of who assigned the course.

summary: Set a Dashboard as your Home Screen, Game results are now saved, with a Hall of Fame leaderboard widget and idle-triggered automation rules.
details: Finished laser games are now recorded, so scores survive a server restart instead of being lost the moment the next game starts.
Added a Hall of Fame dashboard widget showing top scores, best accuracy and team totals over Today, This Week, This Month or All Time.
The Hall of Fame widget can be pointed at a single kiosk or left venue-wide, and each section can be turned on or off.

Fixed player accuracy and team not updating during a game - both were frozen at whatever the first score packet of the game reported, so accuracy read far lower than it should have on the live scoreboard.
Automation rules can now be triggered by a kiosk sitting idle for a set number of minutes, not just by a game starting or ending.
Added a "Stop Projection Program" automation action that stops what is playing on a display and closes the window, so a screen can be cleared when a game starts.
Leaderboard periods reset at local midnight, so a screen running late into the evening rolls over at the right time.
You can now choose any dashboard as your home screen, so it shows instead of the standard home page when you open Lanyard.
Set it from the new Home Screen section on the Account Management page, or straight from the home icon next to any dashboard on the Dashboards page.
Dashboard widgets stay fully interactive on the home screen - buttons, playlist selectors and music controls all work without opening the dashboard.
Clicking the home icon on the dashboard that is already your home screen clears it, putting the standard home page back.
If a dashboard set as someone's home screen is later deleted, they are shown the standard home page again with a note explaining why, rather than a broken or empty screen.
Dashboards now stack into a single readable column on phone-sized screens instead of squeezing every widget into twelve narrow columns.
Fixed the Users page only ever showing the first 10 users, with no page controls to reach the others - it now shows 25 per page with working first/previous/next/last buttons and a total count.
Searching the Users page now jumps back to the first page of results instead of leaving you on an empty page.
Fixed the same problem on the Projection Programs and Projection Templates pages, where anything past the 10th program or template was hidden.

summary: Added a My Training dashboard widget, Added a way for admins and managers to set a home screen for everyone.
details: Added a "My Training" dashboard widget listing your own outstanding courses with their due date and status, overdue ones first.
The My Training widget shows each person their own training, so one shared dashboard works for the whole team.
Clicking a course in the My Training widget takes you straight to it.
The My Training widget can be set to include completed courses, and to cap how many courses it lists.
Courses in the My Training widget are now separated by a divider line with the course name emphasised, so a list of several courses no longer reads as one block of text.
The Users page table can now be sorted by Username, Name, Email Address or Status by clicking a column heading.
The Users page now shows 15 users per page instead of 25.
Editing, deleting or inviting a user no longer sends you back to the first page of the user list.
Admins and managers can set a dashboard as the home screen for everyone, from the new "Everyone's Home Screen" column on the Dashboards page.
Staff who have not picked a home screen of their own now see that dashboard when they open Lanyard, instead of the standard home page.
Setting or clearing everyone's home screen asks for confirmation first, since it changes what the whole team sees.
Anyone who has chosen their own home screen dashboard keeps it - a personal choice always wins over the organisation-wide one.
Added a "Follow the organisation default" option to the Home Screen section on the Account Management page, alongside "Use the standard home page" for anyone who would rather opt out entirely.
If the dashboard set as everyone's home screen is later deleted, staff see the standard home page again with a note explaining why, rather than an empty screen.
Added a Greeting dashboard widget showing the same "Good morning / afternoon / evening" card as the standard home page, with your name.
Added the name of your current location to the footer, so it is clear at a glance which site you are signed in to. This shows on desktop, where the footer bar is visible.
Fixed the "By Person" tab on the Training Dashboard listing every person in the system, so a manager could open the training record of someone at a different location.
The person picker now lists only people at your location, matching the By Course, Timing and Analytics tabs and the bulk assign dialog.
If someone belongs to more than one location, their record now shows only the training assigned at your location.
The deleted-user placeholder no longer appears as a selectable person in the picker.
Fixed the Training Courses page ignoring the location an Admin picked at login - it listed every course from every location, so signing in to one venue looked identical to signing in to another.
Admins now see only the courses belonging to the location they signed in to, plus any shared with it, the same view a Manager gets.
Added a "Show all locations" switch on the Training Courses page so an Admin can still review every location's courses in one list, with a banner making it clear when that is on.
Added a Location column to the Training Courses list, so it is obvious which venue each course belongs to and which courses have no location set at all.
A course created by an admin is now filed under the location they are signed in to, instead of having no location and disappearing from the list it was created on.
The current location now also shows in the header on phone-sized screens, where the footer that normally shows it is hidden.

summary: Admins and managers can now unlock a locked-out user account.
details: Fixed a bug where a login error - such as a locked account, invalid credentials, or a location access error - was not shown, and instead sent the user back to the company selection screen with no explanation.
Login errors are now shown on the login screen where they belong.
Added an unlock icon on the Users page for any account temporarily locked out from too many failed sign-in attempts, so staff no longer have to wait out the lockout timer.
The Users page Status column now shows "Locked" for an account currently locked out.

summary: Tidied up the Training Dashboard's Analytics tab.
details: Fixed the charts on the Training Dashboard's Analytics tab being cut off - a course with a lot of trainees ran off the bottom of its card and over the card below it.
The Analytics cards now all line up at the same height, and grow as tall as they need to so every trainee in a list is visible.
Removed the "Slowest Completions" chart, which on most courses just repeated "Fastest Completions" in the opposite order.

summary: Added Staff Announcements, with a dashboard widget to show them. Added a Projection Status dashboard widget showing live "now playing" progress.
details: Added an Announcements page where managers can post notices for their location - give someone the new "CanPostAnnouncements" role on the Roles page to let them write announcements.
An announcement can be pinned so it always shows at the top, and given an expiry date so it disappears on its own once it's no longer relevant.
Added an Announcements dashboard widget showing the live announcements for your location. Right-click it while editing a dashboard to choose how many to show.
Added a "Projection Status" dashboard widget that shows what's currently playing on a client's display, live, with the program name and a step-by-step progress bar.
The widget updates instantly as playback advances, pauses or is skipped, with no page refresh needed.
The widget can optionally show pause, resume, previous, next and stop controls, so it can be used read-only on a public kiosk dashboard, or with controls on a staff one.
Automation rules can now use a "Projection Program Control" action to start, stop, pause, resume, or skip to the next or previous step of a projection program on a client's display.

Added Pause, Resume, Skip and Stop actions to dashboard Button widgets, alongside the existing Trigger action, so a button can control whatever projection program is already playing rather than only starting a new one.
The Skip button action can be set to skip to either the next or the previous step.
These new button actions are Admin/Manager-only, matching the existing projection trigger button.

summary: Customers can now order and pay for food by scanning a QR code at their table.
details: Added QR code food ordering. Print a code for each table from Kitchen > Menu & Table Codes, and customers can scan it to see your menu and order from their phone - no app to install and no table number to type in.
Customers pay when they order, by card or with Apple Pay and Google Pay. Nothing to settle at the till.
Payments go straight into your own Stripe account. Add it in Companies & Locations; until it's set, the venue can't take QR orders.
Added a Kitchen > Orders screen showing live tickets as they arrive, oldest first, with one tap to move an order through cooking, ready and collected. Orders waiting too long are highlighted.
Orders only reach the kitchen once payment has gone through, so nothing gets cooked that hasn't been paid for.
Cancelling an order asks whether to refund the customer, and issues the refund for you.
Staff can mark a dish as sold out straight from the Orders screen, and it disappears from the menu on phones that are already browsing.

Added three kitchen dashboard widgets: a counts tile (open, cooking, ready, and how long the oldest has waited), a live order queue that shows the same tickets as the Kitchen > Orders screen, and a stats tile showing orders served, average wait and takings.
The Kitchen Order Queue widget can be left read-only for a wall display, or allowed to advance tickets for a screen staff actually work from.
Customers see live progress of their own order, and it survives closing the browser or losing signal.
Added a Public Domains section to Companies & Locations, so a company's customer-facing site can be served on its own web address with its own colours and logo.
QR ordering is off until it's switched on per venue in Kitchen > Menu & Table Codes.
Added a "Kitchen" permission for staff who need the kitchen screens without full management access.
Every dish now carries an allergen declaration covering the 14 named allergens, shown on the customer menu, on the order, and on the kitchen ticket.

A dish stays off the customer menu until someone confirms its allergens - a blank declaration means "not filled in yet", never "contains nothing". Dishes needing one are flagged in Kitchen > Menu & Table Codes.
Added ordering terms and a refund policy, published per company from the new Legal details section in Companies & Locations and linked from the checkout screen.

Orders started but never paid for are now closed off automatically a few hours later, instead of sitting on the books as unpaid. If the payment actually did go through and we simply never heard back from Stripe, the order is recovered and sent to the kitchen rather than cancelled.

The free-text note a customer leaves with an order ("severe nut allergy", "no onions") is now automatically cleared 30 days after the order. The order itself, its items, prices and allergen declarations are kept as normal.
If the ordering site gets briefly busy, customers are now told to try again in a moment rather than being told their table code is wrong.

Added ordering hours. Set a weekly timetable per venue in Kitchen > Menu & Table Codes, and customers scanning a table code outside them are told when ordering opens again instead of seeing a menu they can't buy from. The "Accept QR orders" switch still closes the venue immediately whatever the hours say.
Added a table service mode. With it on, customers are told to wait and that their food will be brought over, rather than being shown a ready-to-collect tracker for food nobody expects them to fetch.

Kitchen receipts can now be printed automatically. Pick which kiosk has the printer in Kitchen > Menu & Table Codes, and a ticket prints there as soon as a payment clears, showing the table, the dishes, any choices and any allergens.

Managers can now be given the Companies & Locations page. They see and edit only their own company - its colours, logo, legal details, documents, venues and domains - and cannot see, let alone change, another company's. Creating and removing whole companies stays with admins.

The ordering terms, refund policy and privacy policy are now edited from Companies & Locations rather than being fixed in the app, so wording changes no longer need a release. Each company can keep Lanyard's wording, edit it, or reset back to it at any time.

The separate registered name, company number, address, contact and collection-window fields have gone. Those details now live in the documents themselves, where you can see them in the sentence they appear in.

Documents are published explicitly. Lanyard's wording is a draft with [blanks] to fill in, and a document is only shown to customers once it is published. A venue can't take QR orders until all three are.
If you don't have two-factor authentication set up, the payout account now says so and the Change button is disabled, rather than letting you fill the form in and refusing at the end.

Only an administrator can change a company's Stripe payout account, and doing so now asks for an authentication code first. Managers can edit everything else about their company but not where the money goes.
The customer site now has a privacy policy, linked from a footer on every page including the ordering screens. Like the ordering terms it is published per company from the Legal details section.
The placeholder marketing pages on the customer site have been replaced with a short "we're building this" page. QR ordering is unaffected and still works from a printed table code.
Removing a logo, tab icon or login background is now a Remove button on the upload box itself, rather than a separate row of Clear buttons at the bottom of the form.

Added a browser tab icon (favicon) for the customer ordering site, uploaded separately from the logo in Companies & Locations, since a wide logo is unreadable at that size. Without one, customers see the Lanyard mark.
Dishes can now have choices, so one dish covers several meals - chips and nuggets with either beans or peas, for example. Set them up per dish in Kitchen > Menu & Table Codes.
Each choice carries its own allergen declaration, which is added to the dish's own on the customer menu, the order and the kitchen ticket.
A single choice can be marked sold out on its own, so running out of beans doesn't take the whole meal off the menu.
The kitchen ticket shows the choices made on each line, so it is clear whether a plate takes beans or peas.
If the ordering site can't reach us at all, customers are now told that and asked to retry, instead of being told their table code is wrong.
Kiosks are now assigned to a venue, on the Clients screen. Only a venue's own kiosks can be chosen as its receipt printer, so one venue's tickets can never be sent to another company's printer.

A customer who ordered just before closing time keeps their live order on screen after the venue closes, instead of the page switching to “we're closed” and losing sight of food they have already paid for.
If we can't tell whether a venue is open, customers are now asked to try again rather than being told the venue is closed.

Staff with the Kitchen permission can now actually use the venue's service settings - ordering hours, table service and the receipt printer - for the venues they work at. Previously the page opened but every change was refused.
A kitchen ticket prints once and only once, even if a payment is confirmed twice at the same moment.
Kitchen tickets are no longer reported as printed when the kiosk is switched off. Staff are warned instead, so a silent pile of missing tickets can't build up.
